text:
Emma: Ok folks — we need to lock pilot scope for the Optimize toolkit work we demoed yesterday. Customers are asking for batching heuristics, quant recs, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we agree on a minimal viable pilot?
Raj: my take: pick 1 batching heuristic + KV-prefetch caching + simple quant recommendation (not full auto-quant) + eval-alerts as opt-in. keep rollout to 3 pilot customers.
Sylvia: +1. Important: pilot must show measurable cost delta and no regression in output quality. we should define acceptance numbers.
Emma: Agreed. Proposal:
- Launch slice: batching heuristic = "short-seq-first + latency target"; KV-prefetch for repeated prefixes; quant rec = suggestion only (e.g. 4-bit vs 8-bit tradeoff)
- Eval-alerts = basic: run eval set daily, trigger alert if quality drop > 3% on key metrics or generation perplexity increases > 5%
- Acceptance: reduce tokens/sec cost by >= 12% on pilot workloads, P95 latency within 1.2x baseline, and alert false-positive rate < 10% during pilot window
Carlos: Where do we capture the eval sets? need clear ownership and a dataset per customer.
Marta: I can own collecting seed evals for 2 customers (SaaS chat + docs summarization). need ask to SAs.
Raj: Can we show a sample of the recommendation UI? we should avoid automatic quant unless client opts in. the rec should include expected latency and quality delta.
Sylvia: For alerts, we need a short circuit — auto-rollback or traffic-shift to a fallback model when quality drops. Otherwise pilots will panic.
Emma: Good point. Add: fallback policy = automatic shift to previous model version when eval drop > 5% AND errors spike. Manual review required for smaller deltas.
ops-bot: deploy/notify: staging deploy for optimize-pilot queued. ETA 2026-03-07 19:00 UTC
Carlos: What about instrumentation? we need token-level cost, per-route latency, and sampling of outputs for eval. This is non-negotiable for pilot acceptance.
Marta: I suggest we add a "pilot config" snippet for SRE/partners. e.g.:
```
pilot_config:
  batching:
    heuristic: short_seq_first
    max_batch_ms: 20
  caching:
    kv_prefetch: true
  quant_recs:
    mode: suggestion_only
  eval_alerts:
    cadence: daily
    thresholds:
      quality_drop_pct: 3
      perplexity_pct: 5
```
Raj: Nice. Also include a simple dashboard widget for daily eval trend and active alerts.
Sylvia: Timeline suggestion: 2 weeks build + 1 week internal pilot + 4 week customer pilot. Total ~7 weeks.
Emma: Budget ask: small infra spike (temp extra capacity) for A/B runs and evals. I'll put in a request to finance.
Carlos: Risks: quant suggestions may mislead engineers to over-compress -> quality regressions. We need guardrails in UI copy and a "simulate" button that shows expected token-level impact.
Marta: And gating: customer acceptance requires at least 2 of 3 pilot customers to sign off on cost/quality tradeoff before we expand.
Emma: Decision log for today: scope MVP = batching heuristic + KV-prefetch + suggestion-only quant recs + eval-trigger alerts (opt-in) + fallback rules. Owners: Emma (product), Raj (algos), Carlos (infra), Marta (customer ops), Sylvia (QA/evals).
Raj: I'll draft the tech spec and a short checklist for pilot gating. Posting by EOD.
Sylvia: I'll assemble eval scripts and baseline metrics; need access to pilot telemetry.
Marta: I'll start customer outreach and collect eval sets.
ops-bot: calendar: product/pilot-sync scheduled 2026-03-10 16:00 UTC
Emma: Thanks team. quick follow-ups: Raj please include PRISM-style examples for UI wording to avoid misinterpretation of quant recs.
Carlos: one more ask — add feature flag for aggressive batching so we can A/B it safely.
Emma: noted. wrapping up — will capture this thread into the initiative doc after Raj posts the spec. :thumbsup:
